title: tiny-svc's expected.json ground truth has no consumer: score-artifacts.sh never opens it and all five dimensions are self-consistency checks, so the eval and its edm-compare-eval baseline tripwire cannot detect an SRD that surfaces zero of the six known gaps -- the fixture README names this scorer as the consumer 'rather than only a self-consistency check'

CA-421 re-flagged, still open: test_frameworks_detected is written every run by edm-test-planner and read by nothing; cmd_get_coverage (:2620-2647) and cmd_metrics_report (:3450-3470) read only coverage_by_layer/coverage_by_epic, so the :1847-1849 provenance comment names two consumers that do not consume it

CA-422 re-flagged, still open: caller_contract_scan extracts only 'edm-state set' (producer direction, :96) and its inverse pass emits a non-failing WARN_UNUSED for keys with no PRODUCER, never for keys with no CONSUMER, so the edm-state:1823-1831 durability rule is unenforced -- proven live by a new write-only key pair landing in commit dc8a24f with the suite green

NEW: code_audit_p2_debt_accepted_at and _accepted_by are written by the --accept-p2-debt branch and read nowhere; they are byte-identical duplicates of code_audit_gate_approved_at/_approver written 7 lines above from the same $t/$a bindings, and those two have three readers while these have zero

NEW: step 8b's tooling-notes.md has no consumer and is absent from both artifact inventories (CLAUDE.md's pass-N block and README.md:194-198), unlike its sibling lenses-run.txt which is in both and has two structural consumers -- so the round-over-round comparison it exists for has no documented reader path
git-lock-check has zero automatic callers but is documented as OPERATOR-INVOKED by name in architecture.md (round-6 resolution) -- filter 1

migrate-path, migrate-schema, set-supersedes, set-forked-from, set-parent and add-related have no skill/agent/hook caller but are documented operator-run CLI entry points and every field they write has a real reader (path derivation, HANDOFF provenance and Related rows) -- filter 1

the WARN_UNUSED product_name / compliance_enabled lines are advisory by design and asserted as such; both keys have real producers outside the scan's 'edm-state set' grep shape and real readers, so they are not the CA-422 class
monitors.json's edm-state watch-impl is argument-less and cmd_watch_impl takes zero arguments; arming is host-managed per CLAUDE.md:700-716 -- external event source, filter 1, wired

all five hook event families resolve to a real dispatch arm (session-start, checkpoint-if-active x2, gate-check x5 matchers, edm-lint-artifacts, edm-qc-auditor + record-partial-verdict); no registered handler is unreachable and no dispatch arm is orphaned

all 20 userConfig keys are consumed -- 16 via ${user_config.*} prompt substitution and four via the env-prefixed form in bin/edm-init (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_MODE/_COMPLIANCE_ENABLED/_IMPLEMENTATION_MODE/_COMMIT_STATE_FILE); no orphan config key

all 30 agents/ files are spawned by a skill or hook (11 lenses + synthesizer from code-audit, qc-auditor from implement and the SubagentStop hook, the rest from their owning phase/test skills); no orphan agent definition

timing.sh and evals/tiering-matrix.sh are excluded from run-all.sh auto-discovery by design (CA-328) but are reached by real --self-test assertions in wave7-smoke.sh:4435-4449 and :4798-4803 plus both CI lint globs -- filter 1

the fixture README claims lint:file-type-ban runs 'du -sk plugins/edm/evals/' but the job sums git ls-files | wc -c (.gitlab-ci.yml:342-350), tracked bytes only, excluding evals/runs/ -- a doc naming a mechanism that does not exist, which is L6 comment/error-message accuracy rather than L11 integration wiring; recorded as a cross-lens pointer only
